messages:
laura: Heads-up — saw a 120-200ms tail latency spike on prod-serving between 04:00-04:10 UTC. Correlates with KV cache eviction count jumping.
laura: Pulled a quick pprof sample from the hot node:
```
total: 50s
  35% 17.5s kv::evict()
    12% 6.0s kv::write_back()
    10% 5.0s pager::page_out()
    13% 6.5s runtime::alloc
  20% 10s linear-probe-lru-relink
  15% 7.5s fifo::reinsert_path
```
ashok: Which eviction policy was active on that node? LRU, FIFO, or hybrid?
laura: Config shows: evict_mode=hybrid (LRU primary, probabilistic FIFO fallback when pressure > 85%). threshold=0.85
mike: Noticed fragmentation increase when contexts exceed ~32k tokens. Reuse rate drops from ~0.82 -> ~0.30 after ~10 minutes of sustained long sessions. Paging rate ramps up accordingly.
mike: Quick numbers from staging run:
  reuse_rate: 0.82 -> 0.30 (10m)
  eviction_count: 12k -> 48k (10m)
  page_outs/sec: 0.4 -> 3.7
laura: I can repro locally with a long-context workload. Repro script:
```
wrk -t4 -c200 -d60s --script=long_ctx.lua https://staging.redwood/serve/gen
```
dev-bot: rollout:evict-policy-change started by @ashok at 2024-04-15T04:30Z
ashok: Two quick hypotheses:
  1) LRU relink is cheap usually but under hot eviction it serializes the fastpath (relink + mutex), adding tail latency.
  2) FIFO reinserts create tombstone chains when page_outs interleave with reinserts -> fragmentation -> more page outs and worse reuse.
mike: Profiling shows lock contention around slab allocator during evict. Sample stack (hot): kv::evict -> slab::free -> mutex::lock -> wait
sre-bot: Alerts fired: disk paging count + CPU steal spike. No OOMs. Host load up but service not crashed.
laura: Immediate mitigation suggestion: bump eviction threshold to 0.92 to reduce churn, and enable prefix-KV caching for long sessions while we debug. Rolling to staging now.
ashok: Follow-ups (short):
  - Add per-shard eviction latency histograms (metric kv.evict.latency_p50/p95/p99).
  - Add reuse-rate gauge emitted by runtime; alert if reuse_rate < 0.5 for 5m.
  - Canary test: simulate long-context writeback + reinsertion pattern.
mike: I'll own the histograms + slab contention flamegraph and share results by EOD. :thumbsup:
laura: Also saw a correctness blip: one customer session returned a stale KV token after a reinsertion under FIFO reinserts. Not sure if it's data corruption or a race.
ashok: Repro script points at a race where async page_out completes after a reinsertion path, leading to an overwrite of the reinsertion slot. Suspect missing sequence/epoch check on reinserts. Will open PR to gate reinserts by epoch.
laura: Please include a small unit test that simulates async page_out + reinsert interleaving. We'll run it across staging canaries.
mike: noted.
dev-bot: deploy to staging succeeded for evict-threshold-tmp @ 2024-04-15T05:02Z
laura: Thanks all — once we have histograms + epoch-guard PR we can decide whether hybrid mode is safe or we need to default to LRU-only with tuned backoff. Postmortem draft after fixes. :eyes:
